items.lang|manas_queue|manas_queue.message.ser: Server is restarting. Please reconnect in a moment.
items.lang|manas_queue|manas_queue.message.wel: You have been let into the server! Welcome!
items.lang|mebahelcreaturesdwarven|item.mebahe: §7These arrows are too powerful for Infinity to replicate
items.lang|morerelics|effect.morerelics.corros: A corrosive effect that eats away at equipment, reducing armor.
items.lang|morerelics|effect.morerelics.static: Makes it so the player cannot see other players or mobs.
items.lang|morerelics|effect.morerelics.vulner: Increases incoming damage by %20 per amplifier.
items.lang|morerelics|effect.morerelics.cyberp: Slightly increases speed and damage while significantly improving Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.
items.lang|morerelics|effect.morerelics.overlo: Slightly increases speed. Can be consumed for better Thermal Discharges in Thermoseismic Heart.
Makes it so the entity can miss their attacks.
items.lang|morerelics|effect.morerelics.charre: Increases damage taken from any source by 1 per level of this effect.
items.lang|morerelics|effect.morerelics.accele: Makes the user increasingly stronger when used with Made in Heaven.
A flawless orb with stark white corners, its center a deep purple that seems to pulse with a quiet, simmering anger. It radiates an unsettling aura, as if it harbors a grudge.
If you are under a negative effect or on fire, deal %1$sX extra damage.
This relic gains 2 experience each second the user is affected by a harmful effect or is on fire.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.slumberin: A simple, unremarkable necklace lacking distinction, yet something about it feels off as if it were destined for a greater purpose.
This relic brings a soothing comfort, making you feel compelled to wear it more.
While wearing the amulet, thoughts of Nether Stars fill your mind, and visions of them appear in your dreams. A strong urge to hold one begins to rise within you.
Carrying this relic fills you with a sense of comfort, providing 1 experience point per second. This experience is not shared with other relics.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.whisperin: Tendrils of pure light unfurl from the amulet, twisting and thrashing with frantic energy as if they are reaching for something just beyond the veil, a place they desperately seek.
The amulet hums softly, its whispers winding through your mind, guiding you toward a place it insists you must go.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.made_in_h: The amulet has unlocked its full potential, transforming into its true form. It now seems to share a bond with you.

Made in Heaven channels its power into you, increasing all your stats by %1$sX.
Hitting an enemy grants Accelerating, stacking up to 10 times. Each stack boosts all stats except health by 0.03X. Gaining stacks has a %2$s second cooldown and all stacks expire after a short duration of not attacking.

While at 10 Accelerating stacks gain an additional %2$sX stat boost and automatically revive with half your maximum HP when you die.
Triggering the revive puts it on cooldown for %1$s seconds and consumes all Accelerating stacks.
The amulet is happy to spend time with you, granting it 1 experience per second. This experience is not shared with other relics.

Upon activation, unleash holy fire in a cone, dealing %2$s damage, burning enemies and applying Charred for a duration.
Charred causes affected enemies to take 1 extra damage per level from all sources.
Cooldown: %1$s seconds.

Upon activation, rise into the air and after a short delay engulf everything within a 7-block radius in holy fire, dealing up to %1$s damage over 5 seconds in 5 increasing hits and burning enemies. The last 3 hits apply and stack Charred.
You gain 60% damage reduction while casting this ability.
This ability can only be used while you have 10 Accelerating stacks and has a cooldown of %2$s seconds.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.morerelics.made_: Zenith has shielded you from death and is now on cooldown.
Zenith is ready to revive again.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.mass_gaun: A gauntlet with a massive iron ball affixed to it, designed to force the user's body to move in sync with their strikes. This unique design amplifies the power of each attack as the user's weight is channeled into every blow.
Your attacks deal %1$s% of your maximum health as extra damage.
The gauntlet gains 2 experince every time you attack.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.eject_but: A yellow box with a red, glowing button. Engineered for "heroic and tactical" retreats.
Grants %1$sX speed when the user's health falls below 20%.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.shieldwea: A cape woven with steel-like threads that adjust to the wearer's armor, covering weak spots.
The cape hardens upon impact, blocking the hit with %1$s% + %2$s% * armor chance (max 33%).
The cape covers your weak spots, increasing your armor by %1$s%.
The cape gains 2 experince every time it blocks an attack.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.axolotl_c: A light pink cream. Enhances healing and smells like strawberries.
Increases healing from any source by %1$sX.
The cream gains 2 experience every time you heal.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.morerelics.axolo: Don't ask how it is made
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.sentient_: A cluster of Ferro Comedenti fungi, a rare species of fungus which rapidly corrodes metal on contact. Commonly known as 'Sentient Rust' for its reddish hue.
Applies an armor-corroding effect for %1$s seconds. Consecutive hits refresh the duration and stack the effect (up to 10 times). Each stack reduces armor by %5.
The fungi gain 1 experience every time you attack.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.opal_neck: A silver necklace adorned with a small opal stone, traditionally gifted to travelers and soldiers venturing into barren lands, symbolizing a wish for their safety and protection.
Protects from all damage once, then goes on cooldown for %1$s.
The necklace gains 5 experience every time you block an attack with it.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.tyrant_ma: A brass mask once worn by a forgotten tyrant. Though his soul is long gone the mask still brims with malice, drawing restless spirits and trapping them within its dark influence.
The trapped souls within the mask hinder you, lowering your speed, damage, and attack speed by %1$s%.
The souls trapped within the mask regret avoiding change and living a monotonous life. Perhaps travelling with them could soothe their longing for adventure.
The souls trapped within the mask crave for revenge against the monsters that slayed them. Perhaps hunting monsters with them could soothe their fury.
The souls trapped within the mask carry the sorrow of a life spent without leaving a lasting mark. Maybe building with them will help soothe their need to create.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.morerelics.tyran: The trapped souls within the mask are freed.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.king_crim: Freed souls burst out of the mask, changing its color and leaving a strange hole in the middle. When you look into the hole you can't see the bottom but the other side looks solid.
Distorts time and space, rewinding you to your position from 10 seconds ago. %1$s seconds cooldown.

Your attacks disrupt your target's mind, applying Weakness and Slowness with a %2$s% chance for %1$s seconds. If the target is another player Static is also applied for half the duration.
Your first attack after Epitaph always triggers this effect.

Static makes players unable to see other mobs and players while it is active.
The Court Of The Crimson King

When you attack, if your maximum health is more than or equal to your target's maximum health and their health is below %1$s%, they are instantly executed. If your target has more maximum health than you they instead take double damage below this threshold.
This relic gains 20 experience every time you use Epitaph
This relic gains 2 experience every time a status effect is applied
The Court Of The Crimson King
This relic gains 3 experience every time a target is executed
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.crown_of_: This crown embodies courage. Those who wear it inherit the legacy of a true legend, unshaken in the face of any challenge.
Increases your damage against pig based mobs by %1$sX.

Grants life-steal scaling with damage and missing health.
(1-(Current Health)/(Maximum Health)) * Damage * %1$s
This relic gains 5 experience every time a pig based mob is attacked
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.bionic_ey: A high-tech eye implant that grants the wearer the ability to seek and track targets, highlighting them even through obstacles.

When activated applies Glowing and Vulnerability effects on enemies in %1$s block radius for %2$s seconds. %3$s seconds cooldown.
While cyberpsychosis is active: Has reduced cooldown and applies Vulnerability 2 instead.
This relics gains 10 experience every time you use Seeker.

Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger Cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.
items.lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.thermosei: A high-tech heart implant that converts movement and vibrations into energy, powering itself and recharging its internal batteries.
